notes.content: A typed letter opening Dear Murre, with three paragraphs and no visible date or signature. Paragraph 1 thanks the recipient for notes on the tame fundamental group and apologizes for misleading statements and oral explanations. Paragraph 2 presents an example claimed to refute 1.16 and 3.6 and to invalidate the stated proofs of 3.7 and 3.8. Paragraph 3 questions 6.4 without regular D_i and describes a locally étale formulation of tame ramification along a normal-crossings divisor. These references are reported as the author’s claims; no surrounding pages were consulted.

check_events.outcome: Conditional algebraic verification only: for a commutative ring A and the diagnostic interpretation B=A[T]/(T^n-a), the stated equality a=b^n makes evaluation T↦b descend to B because b^n-a=0. Its composite with A→B is the identity on A, so the induced Spec(A)→Spec(B) is a section of the structure morphism. This checks the section claim under that explicit interpretation; it does not fill the written bracket/arrow blanks, determine H′, or verify propositions 1.16, 3.6, 3.7, 3.8, or 6.4.
